2607.17782.title: BrainNext: A General-Purpose Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Brain MRI Analysis
2607.17782.paper_summary: Foundation models pretrained using self-supervised learning have transformed computer vision by learning transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled data. However, existing foundation models for neuroimaging remain limited by task-specific training, slice-based learning strategies, or relatively small pretraining datasets, restricting their generalizability across diverse brain MRI applications. In this work, we present BrainNext, a general-purpose self-supervised foundation model for volumetric brain MRI analysis. BrainNext combines masked autoencoder (MAE) pretraining with a native three-dimensional Bi-Directional xLSTM-UNet architecture to learn rich anatomical representations from 60,551 unlabeled brain MRI examinations spanning multiple MRI modalities. The pretrained model is subsequently adapted to downstream tasks through lightweight task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate BrainNext on the Foundation Models for Medical Imaging (FOMO) 2025 Method Track, encompassing classification, segmentation, and brain-age estimation, where it achieved second place overall and ranked first in the meningioma segmentation task on the official FOMO 2025 challenge leaderboard, demonstrating strong transferability across heterogeneous neuroimaging tasks. These results highlight the potential of large-scale self-supervised pretraining to learn robust and transferable volumetric representations, establishing BrainNext as a scalable foundation model for diverse brain MRI applications.
2607.17782.paper_summary_zh: 使用自我監督學習預訓練的基礎模型已經通過從大規模無標籤數據中學習可轉移的表示，改變了計算機視覺。然而，現有的神經影像學基礎模型仍然受到特定任務訓練、基於切片的學習策略或相對較小的預訓練數據集的限制，這限制了它們在多樣化的腦部MRI應用中的通用性。在這項工作中，我們提出了BrainNext，一種用於體積腦部MRI分析的通用自我監督基礎模型。BrainNext結合了掩蔽自編碼器（MAE）預訓練和本地三維雙向xLSTM-UNet架構，從涵蓋多種MRI模態的60,551個無標籤腦部MRI檢查中學習豐富的解剖表示。預訓練模型隨後通過輕量級特定任務微調適應下游任務。我們在2025年醫療影像基礎模型（FOMO）方法賽道上評估了BrainNext，涵蓋了分類、分割和腦齡估計，其中它在總體上獲得第二名，並在官方FOMO 2025挑戰排行榜的腦膜瘤分割任務中排名第一，顯示出在異質神經影像學任務中的強大可轉移性。這些結果突顯了大規模自我監督預訓練學習穩健和可轉移的體積表示的潛力，確立了BrainNext作為多樣化腦部MRI應用的可擴展基礎模型。
